operator_facing_summary: MIM located the table, identified the blue block, learned a better side-seat alignment, closed the claw, lifted, and verified the block stayed with the claw during a small base movement and return.
resources_used: Dave PC camera attempted/blocked by local access conflict

learned_alignment.note: Hand angle 89 and side-seat alignment retained the block better than top-down pinch attempts at hand angle 95.

what_worked: Known-good memory got MIM back over the table.
Base direction probing found base 92/100 as useful alignment zones.
Elbow 32 seated the block deeper in the claw view.
Hand angle 89 produced better side-seat retention than hand angle 95.
Closed-claw base +4 verification kept the block in the same claw-relative position.
what_failed: Initial camera pass saw room/floor, not table.
Top-down pinch attempts lifted away without retaining the block.
External observer camera bridge is still weaker than the hand camera.
next_recommended_action: Ask Dave what MIM should do next with the block, or run a controlled place-down routine that opens the claw only after the hand camera confirms the table below.
